configurations.name: skyrunners-dev
configurations.// autoPort: Must stay false. The Google OAuth redirect URL registered in Supabase is http://localhost:3000/auth/callback — on any other port, sign-in fails with a redirect mismatch that looks like an app bug.

configurations.name: skyrunners-worktree
configurations.// why: A git worktree has no .env.local (it is gitignored, so it never gets copied), which means it runs in DEMO mode — no sign-in, no OAuth callback. That is what makes a second port safe here and not on 3000. Use this to check a branch without stopping the dev server on the main checkout.
